extracted.intended_audience: researchers preparing NIH R21/R33 (Microbicide Innovation Program) grant applications; institutional research administrators and investigators
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and assembly of an NIH R21/R33 (MIP) grant application, including required SF424 fields, PHS 398 research plan sections, budgets, biosketches, facilities/equipment descriptions, human/animal protections, consortium agreements, and resource sharing plans. The document is a filled sample application showing required components and supporting documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow funding opportunity's instructions for application format
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format. Although this application demonstrates good grantsmanship, time has passed since the grantee applied. The samples may not reflect the latest format or rules. NIAID posts new samples periodically: https://www.niaid.nih.gov/grants-contracts/sample-applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the FOA-specific instructions; check the sponsoring institute's sample applications for updates. Do not rely on outdated formatting examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: SF 424 (R&R) — Required application fields and certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: The SF 424 (R&R) Application for Federal Assistance must include type of submission, applicant information (DUNS, legal name, address, contact person), employer identification (EIN/TIN), type of applicant, signatures, and certification statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all SF 424 fields, include authorized representative signature, and certify that statements are true and complete. Provide organizational DUNS, EIN, and other identifiers as required by SF424.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT: A succinct description of the project, including rationale, key preliminary data, overall goals, and planned aims. Example: summary describing SEVI, preliminary evidence that amyloid-binding molecules block semen-mediated enhancement of HIV-1 infection, proposal to explore SEVI-targeting agents as microbicides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize the problem, hypothesis, innovation, specific aims (brief), and anticipated impact. Convey feasibility and the staged plan (R21 then conditional R33) where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Health Relevance Statement (Project Narrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: PROJECT NARRATIVE / Public Health Relevance Statement: One-paragraph statement describing the public health importance of the proposed research (e.g., need for new approaches to prevent HIV transmission).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain in plain language how the work addresses an important public health problem and the potential impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims section (listed in Table of Contents): clearly enumerated aims of the research plan (e.g., Aim 1 generate/test derivatives, Aim 2 examine interactions with female reproductive tract cells, Aim 3 SAR refinement and explant testing, final Aim toxicity/irritation and RVI model).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State measurable aims that frame the Research Strategy and where applicable define milestones that determine progression (e.g., from R21 to R33).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy / Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy: detailed plan of experiments and methods to accomplish the Specific Aims, including preliminary data, rationale, experimental design (panels of virus strains, toxicity assays, cervical explants), and planned analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sufficient methodological detail to demonstrate feasibility and rigor; include panels, controls, and plans for interpretation. For phased awards, include criteria/milestones for progression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Milestone-driven progression (R21 -> R33)
rubrics_metrics.description: R33 phase will be undertaken only if well-defined milestones are achieved during the R21 phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define clear, measurable milestones in the application that will determine eligibility to progress to the R33 phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects involvement and Protection of Human Subjects section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether human subjects are involved. If YES: provide IRB approval date or indicate pending, provide Human Subject Assurance Number, and include Protection of Human Subjects narrative describing risks, protections, consent, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respond to human subject questions on the Other Project Information form and include full Protection of Human Subjects documentation (exemptions, risk minimization, monitoring).

rubrics_metrics.name: Women & Minorities (inclusion) and Planned Enrollment Table
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Women & Minorities inclusion plan and a Planned Enrollment Table documenting participant demographics and enrollment projections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address NIH inclusion policies with justification and planned recruitment strategies; include enrollment targets by sex/gender and race/ethnicity where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Children (inclusion of children)
rubrics_metrics.description: Address whether children are included in the research and provide justification and protections when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIH policies on inclusion of children and supply required documentation in the Human Subjects sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals section and IACUC documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used; if YES provide IACUC approval status (pending or date), IACUC approval date, and Animal Welfare Assurance number. The Facilities/Animal resources should show AAALAC accreditation and compliance with OLAW/USDA as relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full vertebrate animal protocol information, justification for species and numbers, and documentation of institutional animal care assurances and accreditations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project involves select agents and provide required select agent research documentation where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If select agents are involved, include registration, containment, and oversight documentation per federal rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proprietary/privileged information and environmental impact questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Project Information requires answers about proprietary/privileged information inclusion, environmental impact (EA/EIS) and exemptions, and whether the project involves activities outside the U.S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose proprietary content and environmental considerations; provide explanations and documentation for any environmental assessments or exemptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed description of laboratory, clinical, animal, computer, office, and other shared facilities available to the project (e.g., lab sq. ft., BL2+ facility, tissue culture hoods, microscopes, flow cytometers, vivarium capabilities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate adequacy of institutional resources and environment to support the project; list shared equipment, core facilities, and administrative support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major Equipment and Core Facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: List and describe major equipment and core facilities accessible to the investigators (e.g., sequencing instruments, confocal microscopes, mass spectrometers, Flow Cytometry Core, HTS Core, Proteomics Center, Vivarium).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show institutional investments in instrumentation and cores and specify access arrangements (shared, dedicated, cores).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Senior/Key Person — Biographical Sketches
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide biographical sketches for each listed Senior/Key Person, showing qualifications, relevant experience, and roles (e.g., PD/PI, co-investigators, consultants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use NIH biosketch format; align expertise with proposed roles and percent effort. Include consultants' commitments and planned contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget (Year-by-Year and Cumulative) and Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed Research & Related Budgets for each year (Year 1–5 as applicable), cumulative budgets, consortium/subaward budgets, and a Budget Justification explaining personnel, supplies, subcontracts, and other costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA-specific budget formats and provide clear justifications for requested funds, including subcontract allocations and percent effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual arrangements and Subcontract documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe consortium/subcontract relationships, roles/responsibilities of subcontractors (e.g., subcontract for R33 phase for in vitro/in vivo testing), and confirm awareness of NIH consortium agreement policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include subaward budgets, a statement of commitment from partner organizations, PI of subcontract, and any inter-organizational agreements; specify tasks and deliverables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support / Consultant commitment letters
rubrics_metrics.description: Include letters of support that document collaborators' and consultants' willingness to participate, describe offered resources (e.g., explant models, assays), and outline planned roles (e.g., consultant during R21, coinvestigator during R33).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters should be specific about contributions, percent effort, availability of unique resources, and commitment to review progress or perform milestone-driven activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan (data and reagents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Resource Sharing Plan: how data and reagents will be shared (presentations at meetings, open-access or delayed free access publications, and distribution of reagents/clones after publication via Biological Material Transfer Agreements or AUTM Simple Letter implementing UBMTA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe timelines and mechanisms for sharing (e.g., immediate availability after publication subject to MTA), venues for dissemination (conferences, journals), and policies for transfers to non-signatory institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Checklist items (Inventions & Patents, Program Income, Disclosure Permission)
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Checklist requires disclosure of inventions and patents, anticipated program income with amounts/sources by budget period, and whether the Government may disclose project title and PI contact info if the application is not awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer checklist items accurately and provide details for any 'Yes' responses as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: FOIA and Confidentiality / Redactions
rubrics_metrics.description: Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) note: NIH is committed to protecting the integrity and confidentiality of peer review; FOIA responses are subject to exemptions and will include substantial redactions to protect confidential commercial/financial information, reviewer comments and deliberations, and personal privacy information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be aware that FOIA requests may lead to redactions and that certain sections (e.g., reviewer comments) are confidential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 508 Conformance and Accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Note on Section 508 Conformance: sample has been reformatted to improve accessibility; contact information for accessibility assistance provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure application materials are accessible and provide contact for help if issues arise for users of assistive technology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Performance Sites listing
rubrics_metrics.description: List all Project/Performance Site Locations with organization name, street, city/state/country, ZIP, and congressional district.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate addresses and identify primary and additional sites where research will be performed.
